Strong Right.why: ימין is masculine, so ימין חזקה is a gender error; ימנית חזקה is the boxing idiom a commentator shouts for a hard right (it is a rocket punch).

Millet Dumpling Star.why: Fans know the Wano item as קיבי דנגו and the existing policy row Lethal Millet Dumpling Star already says כוכב קיבי דנגו; כופתת דוחן is clunky to shout. If the owner wants the Wano dialogue word inste

Three-Sword Style.why: חרב is feminine, so שלושת is a gender error (common in speech, wrong in edited subs); שלוש also matches the sibling rows שתי חרבות and חרב אחת. Drop the hyphen.

10,000 Kilo Press.why: Press=מכבש (a 10,000-kilo steamroller) is natural; Guillotine=גיליוטינה. If the Guillotine card carries Lethal, prefix מתקפה מיוחדת: like Usopp.

Bubble Master: Soap Sheep.he: אמנית הבועות: כבשת סבון! ענן כבשים: בועות מרגיעות
Bubble Master: Soap Sheep.why: Kalifa is a woman announcing herself, so אמנית not אמן; second move as proposed.

Franky Radical Beam.why: קרן פרנקי is definite (proper name), so the adjective needs the article: קרן פרנקי הרדיקלית. The cards split Franky... / Radical... / Beam, so the pieces are פרנקי... / קרן... / רדיקלית.

Candy Wall.why: User is Perospero (Whole Cake Island), not Mr. 3, so Candy is correct; our WCI dialogue says ממתק/ממתקים about 3 to 1 over סוכרייה, and סוכרייה as a material sounds odd. Wall=קיר like Netflix קיר נר.

Cannon Firing.why: The Israeli command is תותחים, אש; ירי תותח is a noun phrase nobody shouts. Keeps English card order (Cannon... / Firing).

Fishman Karate.why: Netflix and Wikipedia both say אנשי הדג, and rows 135/136 already use it; drop the hyphen so the base is one form everywhere.

Shishi Kebab.why: שיש קבב means nothing in Hebrew (שיש is marble); שישליק is the Israeli word for shish kebab and even keeps the shishi sound. Use it for the bare Kebab card too.

Yasakani Sacred Jewel.why: Parallel to מראת יאטה הקדושה (row 69); the comma version reads like a sentence, not a name.

Age Skewer.why: שיפוד גיל reads as 'Gil's skewer' (גיל is a common first name); שנים (years) is what Toshi means and sounds like an attack.

Candy Maiden.why: Perospero; Iron Maiden is עלמת הברזל in Hebrew, so עלמת הממתקים keeps the pun; ממתקים as in rows 73/126.

Candy Wave.why: Perospero; ממתקים like the WCI dialogue and rows 73/125.

Flame Commandment.why: מצווה is a Jewish religious word and sounds comic in a fight; צו (decree) is punchy and neutral and still carries 'commandment'.

Garb-Garb Technique.he: טכניקת בגד-בגד! בגד-בגד: חברת ההלבשה של קין
Garb-Garb Technique.why: Fruit double as in דלת-דלת; the shop gag reads better with the double first.

Max 200 Million Volts: Vari.he: מיליון וולט: וארי! מקסימום 200 מיליון וולט: וארי
Max 200 Million Volts: Vari.why: Spelling מיליון; both pieces as proposed.

Mole-Mole Impact.why: User is Miss Merry Christmas; התנגשות is a traffic-collision word nobody shouts, מכה is; single חפרפרת matches her other moves in the episode.

Pound! Pound! Pound! Pound.why: Nobody chants the noun חבטה; בום is what an Israeli kid shouts whacking mole holes.

Shooting Star Soba Kick.why: Three bare nouns in a row do not parse; the colon makes it 'Soba Kick: Shooting Star' like the other X: Y names.

Shrouds and Ratline Knot.why: Ratlines are literally a rope ladder (סולם חבלים); 'masts and ropes knot' is vague. Sailors' word for shrouds (ונטות) is too obscure.

Tenfold Axe.why: כפול עשר is how Israelis actually say 'x10' out loud; פי עשרה is textbook.

Usopp Aah-eeh-aaaaaah.why: It is the Tarzan yell; the current string drops the 'eeh' (אי) and the Hebrew Tarzan yell is written אה-אי-אה.

Big Chop.why: קיצוץ is kitchen mincing and is already reserved for Sanji's Haché; a blade hack is חיתוך.

Cien Fleur: Wing.why: Robin sprouts a pair; Hebrew says כנפיים, a single כנף sounds like one wing.

Clone-Clone Montage.why: Hyphenate like צ'ופ-צ'ופ and בשל-בשל. Prefer שיבוט over the dialogue's קלון-קלון: קלון means disgrace, so פרי הקלון-קלון reads 'the Shame-Shame fruit'; fix the dialogue line to match.

General Cannon.why: Bare תותח גנרל reads like an adjective ('general-purpose cannon'); 'the General's cannon' is the natural Hebrew possessive for the General Franky mech.

Guard Point: Guard Boost.why: נקודת שמירה means a guard post (security shift) to Israelis; הגנה is the fighting word and the boost half already uses it, so this also removes the שמירה/הגנה mismatch. Touch the three house lines.

Lethal Green Star: Devil.why: כוכב ירוק שטן reads 'green devil star'; the Pop Green sub-name needs its own colon like the Platanus row.

Lethal Green Star: Platanus Shuriken.he: מתקפה מיוחדת: כוכב ירוק: פלאטאנוס שוריקן
Lethal Green Star: Platanus Shuriken.why: Hygiene: stray space before the colon. Optional: platanus is דולב in Hebrew (שוריקן דולב) if the owner wants plant names translated.

Lethal Six Chain Viper Star.he: מתקפה מיוחדת: כוכב צפע כפול שש
Lethal Six Chain Viper Star.why: כוכב הצפע שש החוליות is broken Hebrew (noun pile with no linking word). Six-chain = six shots in a row; כפול שש is how kids say x6 and it shouts well.

Lethal Uso-pper Hammer Comet.why: The pun is Usopp+Chopper; אוסו פר is two meaningless words, while אוסוצ'ופר lands instantly for any Hebrew viewer.

Mole Banana! Mole Banana! Banana! Banana.he: חפרפרת בננה! חפרפרת בננה! בננה! בננה! בננה
Mole Banana! Mole Banana! Banana! Banana.why: Inner exclamation marks are already used in the Sanji butcher rows; without them the chant is an unreadable run-on.

Pound! Pound! Pound! Pound! Pound! Pound.he: חבטה! חבטה! חבטה! חבטה! חבטה! חבטה
Pound! Pound! Pound! Pound! Pound! Pound.why: Same chant word as Usopp Pound, with the inner exclamation marks the other chant rows use.

Ripe-Ripe Seduction Technique.why: Same JA move as Ripe-Ripe Enticement Arts; use one string. Dropping the ה avoids the gender clash (אמנות is feminine, בשל is masculine).

Roar! Lion Fire.why: It is a command to the lion then the attack name; the exclamation mark reads better than a comma and matches the other inner-! rows.

Round Turn.why: כריכה is binding a book; wrapping rope around something is ליפוף.

Snow Powder Makeup.why: Makeup powder is פודרה in Hebrew, so 'snow powder' as makeup is one punchy word pair; איפור שלג אבקה is three stacked nouns.

Triple Exploding Stars.why: X משולש is the standard Hebrew for triple-X and keeps the vocab noun intact; שלושה כוכבי... is a sentence, not a shout.

Water-Water Pistol.why: The whole joke is Luffy parodying גומו גומו נו... אקדח; mirroring the prefix makes the parody land for anyone who has heard it fifty times.

Gum-Gum Bursting Cactus Star.he: מתקפה מיוחדת: כוכב קקטוס מתפוצץ! גומו גומו נו... גאטלינג
Gum-Gum Bursting Cactus Star.why: Split confirmed: Usopp's Lethal card and Luffy's Gatling card.

Lethal Gatling.he: מתקפה מיוחדת: כוכב קקטוס מתפוצץ! גומו גומו נו... גאטלינג
Lethal Gatling.why: Split confirmed, same moment as the Bursting Cactus Star row.

New Year's Dragon Twister.why: Split confirmed; both pieces already in vocab.

Oni Dragon Twister.why: Split confirmed with vocab terms. Note חיתוך השד can also be read as 'breast cut' (שד = breast and demon); vocab issue, not this row's.

Two-Sword Style: Eisen Back.he: סגנון שתי חרבות: גל הנץ! מגן ברזל
Two-Sword Style: Eisen Back.why: Split confirmed; מגן ברזל keeps Eisen = ברזל.

Monster Point.why: Wikipedia leaves it in English; our subs already said נקודת מפלצת
